title: Unable to discard Omnipod Dash pod after error POD fault :028 Alarm pump expired
body: App version: 4.0.0-dev Build 05058858dd-2026-04-29 I have same problem as closed case. #4774 After pod expired, it start beeping. I kill it by screwdriver in pcb. It stops beeping. https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4fb9b60c-5a2c-45c0-b9a3-4b672aa6888a How to trigger forgetting the pod? Thanks @MilosKozak, any help appreciated before I have to run the pod by his PDA.
